title: Tuatha Dé Danann weather-control magic
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Tuatha Dé Danann weather-control magic, about mythological past at Ireland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: specifically the Tua Donan, which are the mythological gods of Ireland, they had magic, specifically magic to control the weather.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man who talks about the purpose of ancient monuments, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the Tuatha Dé Danann, whom he describes as the mythological gods of Ireland. He says that they had magic, and specifically magic to control the weather. He brings it up because it would fit his idea that ancient people knew ways to shape the weather.
